app.name: GymSpot
app.tagline: Smart station coach for your gym: counts reps and corrects form in real time.

legal.medicalDisclaimer: This system is not medical advice. Stop if you feel pain.

calibration.consentCheckbox: The participant gave explicit consent to the calibration recording

login.useInvite: Use the invite link your gym sent you to sign in.

consent.title: Information and explicit consent
consent.checkbox: I have read the notice and give explicit consent to camera use.
points: Your camera image is processed only on this device; it is never stored or sent anywhere.
Only results such as rep counts, fault types and durations go to the server.
No face recognition is used; your QR code identifies you.
You can withdraw consent at any time in settings; you then log your sets manually.
You can download your data or request its deletion.

settings.consentOn: You have consented to camera use.
settings.consentOff: No camera consent; the camera stays off.
settings.deleteConfirm: All your session data and your account will be deleted. Are you sure?
settings.deletionRequested: Request received. Your data will be deleted within 30 days.

login.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.

detail.loginLinkHint: The link is valid for 15 minutes and works once. Give it only to the member; safest is to scan the QR code with their own phone.

templates.inUse: This template is assigned to a member and cannot be deleted.
templates.name: Template name

noticeText: Camera-based movement analysis is used in this area.
Images are processed only on the station device; they are never recorded or sent anywhere.
Members using the system have given explicit consent. If you prefer not to appear on camera, stay outside the station area.
Please ask the gym management if you have questions.
settings.eraseConfirm: All data of {{name}} will be permanently deleted. Continue?

manual.hint: The camera is not used. Enter your reps after the set.

home.station: The fixed tablet at a station. Runs the exercise handed over from the member's phone.
home.member: Your program, sessions, history and progress.
home.admin: Stations, members, program templates and gym settings.
